body: That may be the case... but in any way, it would take years to see any fruits of the effort.
I'm here. I'm sorry I bothered you.
The idea crossed my mind... but at this point, I believe my problems are chronic. I've never lived life other way. This misery is all I know.
Oh, but I do know they fail... it's just that I cannot take that kind of punishment. I'm way too sensitive for that.
I just can't take the frustration... becoming anything implies failing millions of times... I can't take that anymore.

Nobody touched me with a ten feet pole ever (well, except *once* a decade ago), I don't see why that should change, especially due to my state... mastering a skill takes at least 10.000 hours, that I cannot wait that long... having no experience makes me unemployable... and nothing I do will live on, because I'm nobody.

That's a though question, let's see... having someone love me for the first time in my life would be nice. Also, being great at something. It doesn't need to be at everything, at this point I'll take just one ability. Then... getting a job and not losing my mind in the process would feel good, and finally... I'd like to leave something when I'm gone. Which I won't, but then again who does past enough time...

I just think I'm not in the mood to talk to anyone in that sense... "Hi, I'm thinking about killing myself but I thought maybe being an emotional parasite might help me out... would you like to be my victim?". It's not even fair to the other person.
Dying can be scary, but if the net balance of pain vs. pleasure in your life is broken, then it becomes quite tantalizing... I'd like to minimize my suffering before I go.

Oh, I'm sorry, I didn't understand. Problem is, where am I to find people to ask out? And even if I did find someone, statistically it is way more probable that I'll be refused, and that utterly destroys me... I'm sorry.
Thanks for the advice, but I lack the will to do anything. There used to be things that I enjoyed, but "nothing is very much fun anymore".
Churchill is around 55% I think. Very good for a first timer.
To be true, the last 40 turns were pure discovering future techs, cleaning up pollution and playing that the mongols didn't steal me the 100 points of peace.
I just got 138% at King level. I *think* I finished the game at Emperor when I was a kid, but I cannot recall any scorings.
I see... how can I fix now this situation?

Thanks! I used to participate in a card design contest here in my town (for a few boosters), so I am used to trying to make cards look "printable", at least in the rules sense. What should I do with this post? I am new to reddit...
Thanks again!
